senses.gloss: c. pl. (כָּמַהּ to be hot, to thirst, long for) a kind of mushroom, morils.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 69">Gen. R. s. 69</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>כמה</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 63:2">Ps. LXIII, 2</cite>) <he>ככ׳ הללו שהן מצפין וכ׳</he> like those morils which look out for water; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 119:7">Yalk. Gen. 119</cite> <he>כַּכְּמֵהִיּוֹת</he> (not <he>כמ׳</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 786">Yalk. Ps. 786</cite> <he>כאמבטאות</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Nedarim 55b:4">Ned. 55ᵇ</cite>; Y. Maasr. I, 48ᵈ top, <he>כ׳ ופטריות</he> morils and truffles which are not planted; <cite ref="Berakhot 40b:14">Ber. 40ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
